selected_priority: Calibrate opportunity queue ranking from persisted interview, rejection, closure, and offer outcomes while keeping learned weights separate from factual candidate evidence.
displaced_capability: The queue had strong fixed requirement/company/freshness weighting but could not learn from actual application outcomes. Persisted lifecycle responses and strategy assessment artifacts existed without an executable path that converted them into bounded ranking improvements.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: The stranded compiled recruiter-site lineage was inspected first. Current main already contains a materially stronger recruiter compiler with exact-head public capability proof validation, richer route controls, and stricter fail-closed boundaries, so restoring that older surface would regress capability.

A full external optimizer or ML dependency could learn richer models, but current outcome volume is expected to be sparse and such a system would overfit early evidence while expanding infrastructure before the feedback loop is proven.

Selected: reuse the existing application lifecycle, OPPORTUNITY_ASSESSMENT, COMPANY_FIT_ASSESSMENT, and safety-lane queue; learn only bounded correlation-guided weight shifts with sample shrinkage; then re-rank strictly inside existing lanes and caps.
